fields.description: Reads the scanned pages, values and source boxes. Luna is the default extractor; this model is independent of the verifier.
fields.label: Extractor AI Model

fields.description: Sol verifies extracted values against adapter references using read-only tools. Ambiguity requires human review; only the adapter writes the confirmed result.
fields.label: Verifier AI Model

fields.description: Frappe worker queue used for each individual document extraction.
fields.label: Background Queue

fields.description: Worker timeout is this value multiplied by the number of uploaded pages. Example: 4 pages × 3 minutes = 12 minutes.
fields.label: Timeout per Page (minutes)

fields.description: Block draft creation until every extracted value has OCR-verified or reviewer-marked source evidence.
fields.label: Require Verified Evidence

fields.description: Enables the semantic item-matching layer. If off, matching uses learned memory + fuzzy + LLM only.
fields.label: Enable Semantic Matching

fields.description: Ollama runs a lightweight embedding model (EmbeddingGemma) locally — no API key, no external calls, invoice data stays on your server.
fields.label: Embedding Provider

fields.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.
fields.label: Ollama Base URL

fields.description: Ollama: embeddinggemma (run 'ollama pull embeddinggemma') or nomic-embed-text. Google: text-embedding-004.
fields.label: Embedding Model
